papers.title: Beyond Provenance: The Economics and Governance of Personalized AI Memory
papers.titleZh: 超越溯源：个性化AI记忆的经济学与治理
papers.abstract: Personalized AI memories, defined as persistent decision-relevant states distilled by platforms from long-run human-AI interaction, are increasingly portable, provenance-certifiable, and tradable. Provenance answers the question of origin, but it does not settle who holds which rights over a memory, nor how wider deployment affects its future supply. We develop a unified model in which memory use is non-rival, while refresh, the maintenance of continued validity, is relationally co-produced by the represented individual and the platform. Even assuming perfect provenance and complete information, the model still yields a set of inherent limitations. First, there is an extraction ceiling: decision value is bounded by lived experience. Second, a rights-separation theorem shows that no budget-balanced ownership assignment can make both co-producers residual claimants, and that control rights and cash-flow rights operate on distinct margins. Third, a depletion result indicates that reach-expanding policies such as portability, interoperability, and competition raise current access but shrink the long-run memory stock. Fourth, we offer a formal comparison between memory ownership as it ought to be (subject-held) and as it is (platform-held); the welfare ranking reduces to two measurable quantities, both dominated by interior renewable-claim bundles. Finally, endogenous-quality and market-formation results show that uncompensated markets pollute their own raw material, that transparency and compensation are complements, and that the de facto platform-ownership regime is self-perpetuating. On the design side, the analysis points to separated provenance, performance, and permission credentials; compensation indexed to quality-deployment; and portability and salience, rather than nominal ownership, as the binding policy margins.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着AI代理持续积累用户交互数据形成‘个性化记忆’，这类资产正变得可移植、可认证甚至可交易。然而，仅靠溯源无法解决所有权归属、长期供给激励及广泛部署带来的损耗问题。论文追问：谁应控制这些记忆？现有平台主导模式是否有效？其背后涉及人机协同生产中的激励错配、暴露风险与动态枯竭等深层制度缺陷。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型刻画了一个由个体、平台与买家构成的记忆市场。记忆的使用是非竞争的，但其真实性维护（刷新）需个体反馈与平台工程投入共同完成，且双方努力均不可完全契约化。个体面临部署带来的隐私暴露，平台决定授权范围，双方通过控制权、收益分成与补偿机制互动，形成一个动态博弈结构。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现：第一，决策价值受限于真实经历，存在提取上限；第二，任何预算平衡的所有权安排都无法使双方同时成为剩余索取者，控制权与现金流权利不可互换；第三，扩大访问虽提升短期可用性，却会因激励不足导致长期记忆枯竭；第四，名义上的‘用户所有’与‘平台所有’均为次优，最优解是分离的、基于绩效的动态权益组合。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者构建了一个结合动态博弈与团队激励的理论框架，利用非合作博弈均衡分析揭示结构性矛盾。关键技术包括将刷新技术建模为联合生产函数，并通过边际激励相容条件推导最优权利配置。合成记忆经济的数值实验用于验证理论预测，确保结论不依赖特定参数设定，增强了外部有效性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设完美溯源与完全信息，排除了伪造或认知偏差的影响，这使得结论聚焦于制度本身而非技术缺陷。主要局限在于单平台设定与线性暴露假设。最值得读的是其对‘非竞争使用+竞争性维护’资产的独特建模，以及由此导出的权利分离定理与自我维持的低效均衡机制，为数据治理提供了全新视角。

papers.title: Behavior is Not Enough: A Mechanism-Based Evaluation of Social Norm Emergence in LLM Societies
papers.titleZh: 行为不足以说明一切：基于机制的大语言模型社会中社会规范涌现评估
papers.abstract: Social norms cannot be identified from behavior alone: the same cooperative equilibrium may reflect shared expectations, strategic incentives, or simple imitation. Yet in multi-agent large language model systems, prior work largely treats behavioral convergence as evidence of norm emergence. In this work, we introduce an evaluation framework that measures agents' reported empirical and normative expectations in addition to behavioral convergence. Through controlled ablations, we test the effect of expectation elicitation and isolate two collective mechanisms central to theories of norm formation---social learning through interaction and social selection through network-based group formation. We further test the stability of these resulting dynamics under adversarial disruption across four LLM families. We find that eliciting expectations increases cooperative contributions, while social learning stabilizes behavior, and social selection reliably identifies cooperators but provides limited behavioral reinforcement. Following disruption, normative expectations and behavioral coordination recover differently. Together, these results show that similar cooperative outcomes can arise from different underlying social processes. By making expectations observable, our framework allows us to attribute each mechanism's contribution separately, offering designers of multi-agent systems a principled basis for selecting the social processes that sustain cooperation.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么仅看行为无法判断大语言模型群体是否形成了真正的社会规范？现有研究常将合作行为的收敛视为规范出现的证据，但相同行为可能源于模仿、策略性激励或共享信念。该论文指出，若不区分背后的驱动机制，就难以判断合作是否稳健。它承接社会规范理论中关于经验性与规范性期望的区分，追问在LLM社会中，哪些集体机制真正促成了可持续的合作。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者如何在一个可控环境中模拟并分离不同社会机制的作用？研究构建了一个重复公共品博弈框架，其中12个LLM智能体分组互动，每轮可讨论、贡献、互评并更新网络关系。核心设定包括三个可开关的机制：期望表达（报告他人通常怎么做及自己认为该怎么做）、社会学习（通过讨论传播行为信息）和社会选择（基于评价调整未来组队机会）。通过消融实验，观察各机制对行为与期望的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现，仅仅行为趋同并不能反映规范的真实形成过程。期望表达显著提升合作水平，表明显式反思能改善协调；社会学习使行为更稳定，促进共识维持；而社会选择虽能识别合作者并影响其社交机会，却对行为改变作用有限。更重要的是，在遭遇对抗性干扰后，规范性期望恢复快于行为，说明两者动态不同。这揭示了相似合作结果可由不同机制路径达成。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者如何验证这些机制各自的作用？采用受控的消融实验设计，在四个主流LLM家族上运行多轮仿真，并测量行为贡献、期望一致性及二者对齐程度。通过私有提示获取智能体的经验性和规范性期望，将其作为可观测变量。利用回归分析检验期望差距对后续行为调整的预测力，并通过注入低期望对抗者测试系统鲁棒性，从而分离机制在恢复过程中的角色。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该框架依赖提示工程获取‘期望’，不能等同于人类心理状态，且实验基于简化博弈场景。尽管如此，其价值在于首次系统地区分了LLM社会中行为背后的不同社会过程。最值得阅读的是其系统框架设计与对期望的可操作化处理，为多智能体对齐研究提供了超越行为表象的诊断工具，尤其适合关注长期稳定性与机制解耦的研究者借鉴。

papers.title: Achieving Robust Performance using Minimal Communication in Resource Allocation Games
papers.titleZh: 在资源分配博弈中通过最小通信实现鲁棒性能
papers.abstract: Increasingly, resource allocation games are being proposed to model team coordination in denied communication environments. Of particular interest is understanding the impact of communication denial on the quality of emergent team coordination. In this work, we consider the situation with an arbitrary communication network and use the Price of Anarchy to quantify the quality of emergent behavior. Our main result is a computationally efficient algorithm that calculates a minimal communication network that has the same performance guarantee as the full information case. Additionally, we provide efficient algorithms that compute a Nash and a strict Nash equilibrium in the full information setting. Finally to support these algorithms, we provide sufficient conditions for the existence of a strict Nash equilibrium, characterize strict Nash equilibria across all communication networks, and show that each strict Nash equilibrium in the full information case has a necessary and sufficient set of communication links that induce it. We conclude by giving an execution time experiment of the proposed algorithm and examine several example games.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 本文研究在通信受限环境下多智能体团队如何维持高效协调的问题。现实中灾难救援等场景常面临通信中断，导致个体无法感知全局行动，从而引发重复覆盖或遗漏任务。现有工作多关注完全信息或特定网络结构，缺乏对任意通信拓扑下均衡质量的系统理解。作者追问：能否构造一个通信最少但仍能保持与全信息相同性能保证的网络？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定为单选资源分配博弈，每个智能体从可选任务集中选择一项执行，系统收益取决于被覆盖的任务价值总和，个体效用为其边际贡献。通信网络由有向图表示，智能体仅能观测到邻居的动作。在该设定下，纳什均衡（NE）和严格纳什均衡（SNE）成为分析长期行为的关键，而价格均衡（PoA）用于衡量最差均衡的效率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 核心结果是提出了一个高效算法，能够计算出相对于某个严格纳什均衡的最小通信网络，使得在此网络上的博弈仍能保持原有PoA性能。此外，论文证明了所有SNE均为‘知情’配置（无冗余覆盖），并揭示了最小通信结构的必要性和充分性：缺少任一链路都将破坏原均衡，而增加链路不一定提升性能，甚至可能引入低效均衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造潜在函数与利用边际效用特性，证明了全信息下SNE的存在性，并基于此设计了两阶段算法：先用异步最优响应求解NE，再通过图论中的广度优先搜索寻找通向SNE的最佳响应路径。关键技术在于将弱最佳响应序列转化为图上的最短路径问题，从而实现高效计算。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于结果依赖于非平凡性和资源区分性假设，且最小通信网络针对特定SNE构造，当存在多个SNE时需分别处理。尽管如此，论文提供了对信息结构与博弈性能关系的深刻洞察，其算法具备实际部署潜力。最值得读的是其对‘知情行动’的刻画、最小通信的构造逻辑及高/低信息游戏的划分思想。

papers.title: Strategy-proof choice on strictly convex frontiers
papers.titleZh: 严格凸边界上的策略证明选择
papers.abstract: A collective rule must often choose a public outcome on a constrained boundary. We characterize truthful choice with diagonal unanimity on the entire boundary of any compact full-dimensional strictly convex body in finite dimension at least two. On the full domain of linear support preferences, ordinary individual strategy-proofness and diagonal unanimity force the rule to select one fixed participant's preferred point at every profile. The population is any fixed finite nonempty set. No Pareto condition, boundary smoothness, or continuity or measurability of the rule is assumed. If interior outcomes are allowed instead, two or more participants can use positive fixed weighted averages of preferred points for truthful non-dictatorial compromise on the same type domain. The proof derives regularity from the two agents' incentive inequalities, transports a common support-measure bound across reports, and makes every convexified attainable menu a Minkowski summand of the feasible body. Boundary generation then forces fixed control. The result extends the spherical public-good location question and identifies the role of boundary-valued choice in eliminating truthful compromise.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当集体决策必须从一个封闭曲面上选择公共结果（如球面上的设施位置）时，如何设计规则使每个参与者都愿意真实报告理想点？传统中位数规则在有序结构中有效，但在高维曲面缺乏全局排序，平均方案又会脱离可行边界。本文探究在严格凸边界上能否实现非独裁的诚实共识机制，填补了从线性到曲面空间的理论空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑有限个参与者从紧致全维严格凸体的边界上共同选择一点。每人报告一个单位方向向量，偏好由该方向上线性投影决定，唯一支持点为其理想结果。机制是定义在所有报告组合上的确定性函数，要求满足个体策略证明性（无人可通过虚报获利）和对角一致（全体报告相同时选共同理想点），不假设连续性、光滑性或帕累托最优。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，在至少二维空间中，任何满足上述条件的边界值规则必然是固定独裁：总由某一位参与者的理想点决定结果。这表明在严格凸边界上，诚实与一致无法共存于非独裁机制。相反，若允许内部结果，则加权平均规则可实现诚实妥协，凸显边界约束本身排除了折衷可能。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明通过分析单个参与者的可达菜单展开：利用激励相容性将其转化为支撑最大化问题，结合双人情形的支持包络论证，导出凸化菜单必为可行体的闵可夫斯基和项。再借助严格凸性与边界限制，迫使菜单退化为单点或全集，最终通过单边偏离比较锁定控制者，全程仅依赖个体激励而非联合操纵。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖严格凸性和边界值设定，若允许内部选择则不再成立。结果虽具否定性，但清晰揭示了几何约束对机制设计的根本影响。最值得阅读的是其纯激励驱动的正则性推导、无需光滑性的测度级分析，以及将菜单几何与独裁性关联的技术路径，为高维社会选择提供了新视角。

papers.title: The Depth and Reach of Exploitation: Contracting with Endogenously Naive Consumers
papers.titleZh: 剥削的深度与广度：与内生性天真的消费者订立合同
papers.abstract: Consumers can invest resources to understand and avoid their behavioral mistakes, and their incentives to do so depend on the market consequences of remaining naive. We incorporate this feedback between consumers' cognitive states and market outcomes into a general contracting model. Firms face a trade-off between the depth and reach of exploitation: deeper exploitation raises profit from a naive consumer but induces greater cognitive investment, promoting sophistication and shrinking the exploitable consumer base. This trade-off disciplines exploitation and can cause policies that benefit consumers when cognition is fixed to backfire when cognition is endogenous.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统模型通常假定消费者的认知状态（天真或成熟）是固定的，从而忽略市场行为反过来塑造认知的过程。本文提出一个核心问题：当消费者能通过投入成本变得‘成熟’以避免被剥削时，企业是否会因担心诱导更多人变成熟而自我约束剥削程度？这揭示了一个深度与广度之间的权衡。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定为一个垄断企业向动态不一致的消费者提供合同菜单。消费者在评估合同时处于两种认知状态之一：天真者误以为自己未来会理性履约，成熟者则能预见自己的诱惑。关键创新在于，消费者是否成为成熟者取决于其认知成本与剥削深度的比较，该决策发生在观察到合同菜单之后，使认知分布内生于企业设计。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现，企业面临剥削深度（单个天真用户利润）与广度（剩余天真用户数量）的权衡。更深的剥削虽提升单客收益，却促使更多人投资变成熟，缩小可剥削群体。因此，内生认知会抑制剥削，即使无法消除。更关键的是，一些看似有益的政策可能适得其反。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用静态契约模型结合内生认知投资决策，构建了一个两阶段博弈：企业先设计合同，消费者随后决定是否投资认知。通过定义‘剥削深度’并将其与认知响应函数连接，将企业优化问题转化为关于剥削深度的一维最大化问题，利用凹性与单调性分析均衡解及其对政策变动的反应。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设认知投资基于完全预期，可能高估个体反应能力；且聚焦垄断场景，竞争情形下结论更复杂。尽管如此，论文极具阅读价值，其‘深度-广度’权衡框架为理解行为政策的意外后果提供了统一视角，尤其对机制设计与信息干预研究有深远启发。

papers.title: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn?
papers.titleZh: 玻色高斯态何时在学习上表现为经典？
papers.abstract: A fundamental question in physics is: When does classical behavior emerge from quantum systems? Bosonic Gaussian states provide a natural setting to explore this quantum-classical boundary, as they capture both the classical field behavior and the intrinsic quantum nature of light. Here, we address this problem from a learning-theoretic perspective by asking: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn? That is, under what conditions (if any) can an n-mode bosonic Gaussian state be learned with as few samples, and with operations as simple, as are needed to learn a classical 2n-variate Gaussian distribution? We establish a smooth crossover in learnability governed by the state's thermal fluctuations: - Cold Gaussian states are non-classical to learn: When the covariance matrix satisfies $Σ\le(\frac12+O(\frac1n))I$, i.e. close to the vacuum covariance, tomography under single-copy (i.e., non-entangled) measurements fundamentally requires $Ω(n^3)$ copies, strictly exceeding the sample complexity $Θ(n^2)$ of learning classical Gaussian distributions. We show that this hardness persists even when few-copy entangled measurements are allowed. - Warm Gaussian states are classical to learn: When thermal fluctuations exceed the vacuum noise, parameterized by $Σ\ge(\frac12+ν)I$ for any parameter $ν>0$, we prove that single-copy tomography requires $N=Θ\left(n^2\min(n,1+ν^{-1})\right)$ copies. This bound is tight and is achieved by simple, non-adaptive, unentangled heterodyne measurements. Crucially, for $ν=Ω(1)$, the sample complexity drops to $Θ(n^2)$, matching the classical case. Our results tightly characterize a quantum-to-classical crossover in the learnability of bosonic Gaussian states, reveal a novel connection between fundamental physics and statistical learning theory, and have implications for real-world sensing experiments.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 量子系统在何种条件下会表现出经典的可学习性？本文从统计学习角度切入，探讨n模玻色高斯态的学习难度。尽管其维格纳函数形式上是经典高斯分布，但已知最优学习方案需纠缠测量，远超经典O(n²)样本复杂度。核心问题是：是否存在物理条件使这类量子态可用非纠缠测量以经典效率学习。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为从独立同分布副本中学习未知高斯态，目标是以高概率在迹距离下达到ε精度。对比对象是经典2n维高斯分布的学习复杂度O(n²/ε²)。允许任意POVM测量，重点考察单副本（非纠缠）与k副本纠缠测量下的样本需求。通过热涨落参数ν控制态的‘温度’，探究ν如何影响学习难度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现学习难度随热涨落ν平滑过渡：当ν≪1（冷态）时，单副本学习需Ω(n³/ε²)样本，显著高于经典情形；当ν≥Ω(1)（暖态）时，复杂度降至O(n²/ε²)，与经典匹配。关键结果是异质外差测量在此阈值下达到最优，揭示了从量子难学到经典易学的相变，且该阈值由最小热光子数决定。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 技术路线结合了量子信息与随机矩阵理论。对冷态，通过将有限维态嵌入高斯态并利用后验反集中界，建立Ω(n³/ε²)下界；对暖态，提出单边协方差估计技巧，并证明其在异质外差测量下的最优性。新引入的单边迹距离界摆脱了纯态边界敏感性，是达成紧界的关键。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖于全态层析设定，实际任务常只需估计部分参数。此外，k副本纠缠的紧界仍开放。尽管如此，论文清晰刻画了量子-经典学习的相变机制。最值得读的是其物理洞察：热涨落抑制量子特性，使学习行为经典化，这对量子传感实验设计具直接指导意义。

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Grokking: Weight Decay induces Feature Learning
papers.titleZh: 一种 grokking 的谱理论：权重衰减诱导特征学习
papers.abstract: In grokking an early fit to the training data separates from a much later improvement in generalization. During this delay, training can move from a fixed neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime to one in which task-relevant kernel eigendirections continue to evolve. We provide a quantitative theory for how this transition from lazy to rich learning can produce delayed generalization. For homogeneous networks trained with squared loss and $L_2$ weight decay, we show that a finite residual remains after memorization, with larger residual fractions in target components associated with smaller NTK eigenvalues. These residuals feed back into the dynamics of the NTK itself, and projecting the resulting dynamics onto task-relevant spectral directions yields a reduced system in which residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay. This system predicts that the grokking timescale is controlled by the product of learning rate and weight decay, that feature learning slows logarithmically near a critical decay above which task-aligned NTK structure can no longer support generalization, and that stronger decay can prevent fitting altogether. We test these predictions in modular addition. In a homogeneous MLP, task-aligned Fourier structure continues to emerge in the NTK after training accuracy has saturated, and an 84$\times$90-grid of trained networks across varying learning rate and weight decay recovers the predicted phase geometry and inverse-product scaling of the generalization time with learning rate and weight decay. A one-block Transformer shows similar macroscopic phase structure in a 42$\times$45-grid, as well as the same transition-time scaling despite violating exact homogeneity. Together, these results provide a mechanistic derivation connecting post-fit feature learning to both the onset of generalization and its phase structure in the learning rate and weight decay plane.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么神经网络在训练准确率饱和后很久才开始泛化？这种被称为 grokking 的现象挑战了传统学习理论。现有工作虽观察到训练后期特征和核的变化，但缺乏定量机制解释残差误差如何驱动这些变化并决定泛化时机。本文聚焦于这一延迟泛化的动力学根源，追问权重衰减如何在拟合完成后仍持续塑造特征结构。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在模加法任务上训练的齐次网络，输入为一对整数，输出为其模和的独热编码。模型采用带 L2 权重衰减的全批量梯度流，损失为平方误差。通过监测训练与测试准确率、残差演化及经验神经正切核（NTK）的傅里叶结构变化来评估动态过程，特别关注拟合完成后的缓慢阶段。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了首个连接懒惰到丰富训练转变与延迟泛化的定量理论。核心发现是权重衰减导致拟合后残留非零残差，且其大小与 NTK 特征值负相关，从而驱动任务对齐的 NTK 结构在训练准确率饱和后继续增长。实验在 MLP 和 Transformer 上验证了预测的相图结构与 (ηλ_w)^{-1} 时间尺度。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法基于神经正切层级框架，将残差反馈纳入 NTK 动力学。证明了齐次网络下，权重衰减使小特征值方向保留更大残差比例。将此残差与 NTK 演化耦合，并投影到任务相关的傅里叶模式，导出一个简化系统，其中残差驱动的增长与权重衰减竞争，从而预测出延迟时间尺度和相变边界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 理论依赖齐次网络与平方损失，Transformer 实验虽显示相似宏观行为，但微观机制是否完全一致尚不明确。简化模型忽略了任务方向间的相互作用。尽管如此，论文的价值在于建立了残差→特征学习→泛化的清晰因果链，最值得读的是其理论推导与对 NTK 后训练演化的实证分析。

papers.title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
papers.titleZh: 扩散模型中的双下降与恶性过拟合
papers.abstract: Conventional wisdom in deep learning holds that overparameterization---having more parameters $p$ than training samples $n$---is benign: larger models generalize better and, even without regularization, interpolating models generalize well, the test error following a double-descent curve. One might expect the same benign overfitting for diffusion models, whose training reduces to regression, i.e. to minimizing a quadratic score-matching loss. Yet the opposite is observed: overfitting here is catastrophic, driving the model into a memorization regime. We resolve this paradox by combining experiments on U-Nets trained on CelebA with a random-features model for which we derive closed-form learning curves. We show that with a fixed number $m$ of noise realizations per training sample, an interpolation peak does occur, but at $p\sim nm$ rather than at $p\sim n$ as in standard regression. The rise of the test loss, however, sets in much earlier, at $p\sim n$, independently of $m$. This overfitting is malign because, although the implicit regularization of training is fully at work, it drives the model toward the empirical score, which memorizes the training set, rather than toward the true score. A bias-variance decomposition pinpoints the mechanism: the bias of the score estimator starts to grow at $p\sim n$; past the peak the variance decays, as in regression, whereas the bias keeps growing and both saturate at a large value. Since diffusion models are trained with $m\gg1$, the peak is pushed to very large model sizes, and therefore sit on the rising branch that precedes it, where malign overfitting is already in play. Nevertheless, overparameterization remains beneficial when paired with regularization: in the random-features theory and in U-Net experiments, optimally regularized large models---via a ridge penalty or early stopping, respectively---outperform any unregularized models.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统观点认为深度学习中过参数化是良性的，模型即使插值训练数据也能很好泛化，测试误差呈现双下降曲线。然而在扩散模型中，尽管其训练本质是回归任务，实践中却常出现严重过拟合，导致模型记忆训练数据而非学习真实分布。本文旨在解开这一矛盾：为何同样是过参数化，扩散模型的过拟合却是恶性的？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文通过训练U-Net架构在CelebA图像上的去噪得分匹配任务，并结合随机特征模型进行理论分析。输入是加噪后的图像样本，输出为预测噪声，训练目标是最小化均方误差。评估采用测试损失、经验测试损失及FID等指标，特别关注不同模型大小、样本数n和噪声实现次数m下的学习曲线。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现扩散模型确实存在双下降现象，但插值阈值从p~n移至p~nm，且测试误差在峰值后趋于一个高于初始最小值的平台。这表明过拟合是恶性的：模型被隐式正则化推向经验得分（即记忆训练集），而非真实得分。关键结果是，偏置-方差分解显示偏置在过参数化区持续增长，导致泛化失败。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者结合数值实验与随机特征模型的渐近理论，利用高斯等价原理推导闭式学习曲线。核心在于区分三种损失：训练损失、经验测试损失与总体测试损失。通过分析m对插值阈值的影响，揭示了‘良性’向‘恶性’过拟合的转变机制——训练动态虽仍选择低范数解，但目标已偏离真实得分。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 理论基于各向同性高斯数据与随机特征假设，与实际CNN架构存在差距；实验规模也小于当前主流模型。但论文清晰揭示了扩散模型过拟合的本质机制。最值得读的是其问题设定与偏置-方差分析，为理解生成模型泛化提供了新视角，尤其对正则化策略的设计具有指导意义。

papers.title: Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference
papers.titleZh: 贪心解码并非精度不变：大语言模型推理中的跨精度输出分歧
papers.abstract: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match all five predictions. The best-performing low-overhead intervention we evaluate, selective FP32 LM head recomputation, triggered only when the margin falls below a threshold, delivers +22-36 pp exact agreement on A10G (+12-21 pp on L4 and A100) at less than 4\% latency overhead in low-batch (batch size <=4) single-stream inference. We map the applicability boundary across six models and four batch sizes, and hypothesise that training-time precision stability is a determining factor. The method is a partial mitigation rather than a universal determinism guarantee: its benefit vanishes when body-originated error dominates, including at batch size >=8 and under end-to-end FP8 in our tests.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 大语言模型在实际部署中常因硬件或配置差异，在BF16和FP16两种16位浮点格式下运行同一模型和提示，理论上应产生相同输出的贪心解码却出现不一致。这挑战了确定性推理的基本假设，影响审计、评测和跨平台复现的可靠性。已有框架虽能保证单精度内重复性，却无法解决跨精度分歧，其根源与影响范围尚不明确。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在六款1.1B至7B参数的大模型上，使用GSM8K、HumanEval等公共基准测试，对比相同提示下BF16与FP16贪心解码的输出序列。通过精确测量输出级分歧率、首次分歧位置及最终答案正确性，并结合隐藏状态追踪与干预实验，系统评估了不同模型、批次大小和硬件下的分歧现象及其机制。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现49%至100%的生成存在跨精度分歧，且单个token翻转常引发整个序列的级联偏离。关键贡献在于揭示分歧本质是输出层‘前二logit差距’过小时，低精度舍入误差被放大的结果。基于此，提出的选择性FP32输出层重计算方法，在极低延迟开销下显著提升了输出一致性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是‘选择性修复’：仅当检测到输出层前二logit差距低于阈值时，才将该步的输出投影（lm_head）以高精度FP32重新计算。该设计受误差传播分析启发，证明分歧由输出层主导放大，而非累积于模型主体。五项受控实验证实了其预测，如扩大FP32范围反而会破坏一致性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该方法仅为部分缓解，其有效性依赖于分歧源于输出层的假设。在模型主体因训练精度不稳定导致早期分歧，或批量推理、端到端FP8量化等主体误差占主导的场景下，效果会消失。最值得阅读的是其严谨的因果分析框架，它清晰界定了此类数值不稳定性问题的边界和可修复条件。

papers.title: Gap-Free Streaming PCA Beyond Rank-One Updates: Near-Optimal Rates and Applications to Differential Privacy
papers.titleZh: 无间隙流式PCA超越秩一更新：近最优速率及其在差分隐私中的应用
papers.abstract: Streaming principal component analysis (PCA) seeks to recover a leading spectral subspace in a single pass over a data stream. We give a new analysis of the ubiquitous Oja's algorithm [Oja82] for the most general, gap-free variant of this problem, where no eigengap assumptions are made on the underlying mean matrix, complemented by a nearly-matching lower bound. Prior works achieving near-optimal rates for streaming PCA either required gap assumptions [JJK+16, HNWW21], or were limited to rank-one updates [AZL17, Lia23]. Our proof only uses a second moment bound on the individual stochastic updates, bypassing the almost sure bounds needed by prior near-optimal analyses, and the analogous offline matrix Bernstein bound. We also extend our result to a Rayleigh quotient notion of approximate PCA, addressing an open question of [JJK+16]. As our main application, we give gap-free differentially private PCA guarantees for sub-Gaussian data, settling Conjecture 1.1 of [Bro26] up to logarithmic factors.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 流式主成分分析（PCA）旨在单次扫描数据流中恢复协方差矩阵的主导子空间，传统方法常依赖于特征值间隙假设或仅处理秩一更新。然而，在真实场景中特征值常接近相等，导致经典方法失效。本文关注无特征间隙设定下的通用流式PCA问题，核心挑战在于如何在不依赖间隙和秩限制的前提下，仍能达到近最优收敛速率。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究从独立同分布矩阵序列中估计均值矩阵主导子空间的问题，允许一般矩阵更新而非仅秩一更新。采用相关性PCA（cPCA）和能量PCA（ePCA）作为无间隙评估准则，衡量输出向量在低特征值子空间上的投影质量。通过Oja算法进行迭代更新，并在差分隐私设定下加入高斯噪声，评估其在合成数据上的cPCA误差和成功概率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文首次证明Oja算法在无特征间隙和一般矩阵更新下仍能达到近最优样本复杂度，填补了理论空白。给出了匹配的上下界，并扩展至能量PCA目标，解决了JJK+16提出的开放问题。在差分隐私PCA中，实现了与Brown猜想几乎匹配的样本复杂度，验证了方法在隐私保护下的有效性，显著优于基线方法。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 关键创新在于使用期望迹作为势函数，仅依赖矩阵方差界而非几乎必然界，从而绕开对特征间隙的需求。通过分析随机算子与其均值的偏差，结合三角不等式和von Neumann迹不等式完成控制。在隐私设置中，利用Rényi差分隐私进行噪声组合分析，并通过自适应裁剪控制敏感度，提升了隐私-效用权衡。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 当前结果集中在1-PCA问题，尚未推广到k>1的情形；高成功率保证需额外对数因子的空间开销；理论依赖子高斯性假设，对重尾分布的鲁棒性未探讨。最值得阅读的是其无间隙分析框架、对Oja算法的新视角及在差分隐私中的应用设计，为理论与隐私机器学习的交叉提供了新思路。
